rule: A row gets ok only from a current listing, its own site or recent reviews with nothing saying closed (docs/EATS.md). A row is taken out when a search could not find the place at all or the sources disagree; a place found but not freshly confirmed stays without ok.
scope: the 1 row without ok; the town holds 21 rows after this pass
how: Google Maps opened in headless Chromium (2026-11-23), limited view without a reviews tab, so no review date could be read; searched in English and in the local language, each verdict from the place page or the result list shown
